fields.Name: T321 - Routines App Command Center Render
fields.Description: Exercises the standalone UserRoutines BaseResourceComponent host wrapping the generic UserRoutinesCommandCenter — a bespoke card-list command center, not the generic AG-Grid entity browser or a dashboard.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and switch to the Routines app (icon: a business-time / clock-with-arrow icon). Wait for it to load — pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait and do not navigate away. Success is seeing the Routines command center render: a header titled 'Routines' with a 'New Routine' button and a search box, and below it EITHER a grid of routine cards OR a 'No Routines Yet' empty-state inviting you to create your first routine. You do NOT need to create anything — seeing the surface render is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Routines app opens with a header titled 'Routines' and a visible 'New Routine' button
The body shows either routine cards OR a 'No Routines Yet' empty state (either is a valid pass)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
